name: Bring Good Vibes
definition: We support and celebrate each other, staying positive even in challenging times.

rows.under: Lets the mood set itself, and the team runs on anxiety.
rows.justRight: Is honest about the situation and clear that the team can act on it. Steadiness, not cheer.
rows.over: Insists everything is fine, and people stop believing anything you say.

rows.situation: When someone else does something well
rows.justRight: Says it publicly and specifically, so the behavior is visible to everyone.
rows.over: Celebrates so indiscriminately that recognition stops meaning anything.

rows.situation: When a colleague is having a hard time
rows.under: Treats it as a performance issue and nothing else.
rows.justRight: Asks, listens, and takes something off their plate if that is what is needed.
rows.over: Carries them for so long that the underlying problem is never addressed.

rows.under: Lets it get personal, or goes silent and stays angry.
rows.justRight: Keeps the argument on the work and the tone warm. Hard on the problem, easy on the person.
rows.over: Keeps the tone so pleasant that the real disagreement never gets said.

rows.situation: When you have to deliver bad news
rows.under: Softens it until the message is lost.
rows.justRight: Says it straight, says what happens next, and does not leave people alone with it.
rows.over: Wraps bad news in so much positivity that people do not realize anything is wrong.
